rules.trapName: Failure to Clearly and Conspicuously Disclose Renewal Terms
rules.statuteSummary: Any person that sells or offers consumer contracts with automatic renewal provisions must clearly and conspicuously disclose the renewal terms, including the recurring cost, length of renewal term, and cancellation procedure.
rules.disputeTemplate: Under Del. Code Ann. tit. 6, § 2734(a), automatic renewal provisions must be clear and conspicuous. Failure to clearly present recurring terms renders the clause non-compliant.

rules.statuteSummary: Requires written notice between 30 and 60 days before the cancellation deadline for contracts of 12 months or longer.
rules.disputeTemplate: Under Del. Code Ann. tit. 6, § 2734(b), automatic renewal contracts of 12 months or longer require clear written notice 30 to 60 days before renewal.
